Casserole Sheets A1 Ready
Click a cell, type in the formula bar, Enter commits (Tab moves right; arrows navigate when not editing). Functions: SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT, COUNTA, IF, AND, OR, NOT, ABS, SQRT, ROUND, LEN, UPPER, LOWER, CONCAT. Errors show as #DIV/0!, #CYCLE!, #NAME?, #VALUE!, #PARSE!.
